text:
You need a dependable Sales Support partner who can handle sales coordination, email communication, data entry, and relationship management with accuracy and speed.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports, and monthly close reporting dropped from 3 days to 4 hours. In my Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare attribution models, and that led to 18% of ad budget being reallocated.

I’d be glad to support your sales team. Which tasks will be the highest priority in this role?
